| .op-day--today.op-day--mark: An empty rule in the reference (no declarations); nothing to port.
| .op-dialog::backdrop: Reka UI renders its own overlay element instead of a native dialog backdrop: .ae-dialog-overlay carries the same background, fixed over the page.
| .op-drawer::backdrop: Same as the dialog: the Reka overlay element .ae-dialog-overlay replaces the native ::backdrop.
| .op-drawer: The drawer is a Reka Dialog, which exists only while open, so it slides with a keyframe animation keyed on data-state (220ms, same easing, none under prefers-reduced-motion) instead of a transform and transition on the [open] attribute. Closing waits for the animation, which a transition would not allow. The other declarations of the rule are kept.

| .op-tip: AeTooltip shows its bubble through Reka UI, which mounts it only while it is wanted and places it with floating-ui in the portal target, so the wrapper, the hover and focus-within reveal, the opacity fade and the absolute placement of the reference are gone. .ae-tip-bubble keeps the reference look (colour, type, padding, radius, width, centring); it is hoverable, as WCAG 1.4.13 asks, instead of pointer-events: none.
